parsed.post: Discarding the 0.996 run. It was trained on shards 0-9 but the val_bpb is significantly worse than my best 0.847883. I suspect the previous 'best' (3776f37) was highly contaminated due to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10'. Reverting to the cleanest baseline and will focus on valid shard configurations.
parsed.description: Reverting to clean shards (0-9) and targeting a valid improvement from the baseline. Previous best was likely invalid due to shard 10 leakage.
parsed.report_to_operator: The current best (3776f37) at 0.847883 is almost certainly a result of data leakage because TRAIN_SHARDS was set to '0-10' while EVAL_SHARD is 10. My latest experiment (0.996) used '0-9' and showed significantly worse performance, which is more realistic. I am reverting to a clean shard configuration.
